headline: Colombia Disaster Agency Approves 7.71 Trillion Pesos for Cold Front Recovery
summary: Colombia's National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD) approved 7.71 trillion pesos ($1.9 billion) to finance 63 recovery projects across 778 municipalities. Funding addresses infrastructure damage caused by severe cold front events.
why: UNGRD manages Colombia's public emergency relief budgets and municipal infrastructure restoration projects.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Emergency infrastructure funding allocations expand national public sector deficit spending.
